sn2.22:1.1: Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Khemo devaputto Bhagavato santike imā gāthāyo abhāsi || ||
sn2.22:2.1: Caranti bālā dummedhā || amitten-eva attanā || karontā pāpakaṃ kammaṃ || yaṃ hoti kaṭukapphalaṃ || ||
sn2.22:3.1: na taṃ kammaṃ kataṃ sādhu || yaṃ katvā anutappati || yassa assumukho rodaṃ || vipākaṃ paṭisevati || ||
sn2.22:4.1: taṃ ca kammaṃ kataṃ sādhu || yam katvā nānutappati || yassa patīto sumano || vipākaṃ paṭisevati || ||
sn2.22:5.1: Paṭikacceva taṃ kayirā || yaṃ jaññā hitam attano || na sākaṭikaṃ cintāya || mantādhīro parakkame || ||
sn2.22:6.1: yathā sākaṭiko panthaṃ || samaṃ hitvā mahāpathaṃ || visamaṃ maggam āruyha || akkhacchinno vajhāyati || ||
sn2.22:7.1: evaṃ dhammā apakkamma || adhammam anuvattiya || mando maccumukhaṃ patto || akkhachinno va jhāyatīti || ||
